one_row_means: one synchronized observation and its next action target

columns.name: observation_timestamp_s
columns.description: Canonical observation time; may be nominal if timestamp_source says so

columns.name: action_timestamp_s
columns.description: Time represented by the action target

columns.name: sync_error_s
columns.description: Maximum image/state/action synchronization error for this row

columns.name: observation.joint_position
columns.description: Padded native joint positions; values are meaningful only where joint_position_mask is true

columns.name: observation.tcp_pose_xyzw
columns.description: Two 7D TCP slots in xyz+qx+qy+qz order after an explicitly declared conversion

columns.name: observation.force_torque
columns.description: Optional two-arm [force3, torque3] values; preserve source frame in episode metadata

columns.name: image_frame_index.base_0
columns.description: Video frame index, -1 only when image_mask.base_0 is false

columns.name: action.canonical
columns.description: [arm_0 delta xyz, delta axis-angle, gripper target, arm_1 equivalent]

columns.name: action_mask
columns.description: False dimensions are padding/missing and are excluded from loss and statistics

columns.name: time_mask
columns.description: False only for padded action-chunk rows, never inferred from action value

columns.name: action_native_uri
columns.description: Sidecar/raw reference preserving the original action representation

invariants: A false action_mask dimension must not contribute to normalization or action loss.
A padded numeric zero is not evidence of a valid no-op action.
Every row has an episode-level action_spec and coordinate convention in its metadata sidecar.
Video frame index is valid only when the matching image_mask is true.
